timingGuidance: Use for three related source images or screenshots when the scene needs depth but not a generic card stack.
usageRules: Use only with assets that share a visual family.
Limit to three layers in 9:16 so captions and watermark keep room.
Prefer source-image-reveal for a single asset.

timingGuidance: Use for partner/customer/source logo proof beats where multiple logos need equal visual treatment.
usageRules: Use only when logo use is publishable or review-approved.
Keep all logos optically balanced inside equal cells.
Do not use this as the episode watermark or final outro.

timingGuidance: Use for final 4–6 seconds of standard shorts unless explicitly disabled. The penultimate scene must blur/scale crossfade into this outro, then the brand text reveals with blur-to-sharp scale-up after the logo pieces start assembling.
usageRules: Use as the standard closing brand lockup.
Fade persistent watermark before outro begins.
Transition from the penultimate scene with scene-level blur/crossfade into #scene-brand-outro.
Animate cgaravitoq, AI Engineering, and any source attribution with the standard blur scale-up reveal; keep the text synchronized as one grouped outro reveal, not as a separate CTA card.
Source branding can appear only as attribution, never as the watermark or primary outro brand.
validationRules: requires outro text blur scale reveal

timingGuidance: Persistent track-97 watermark throughout branded shorts; fade before brand-logo-outro to avoid double-logo.
usageRules: Use on branded shorts unless explicitly disabled.
Keep on track 97 and outside scene-local tracks.
Position: top-right safe area (top: 96px, right: 96px).

timingGuidance: 7–9s scene; reveal shell, grow bars, draw line, then reveal labels and KPI.
usageRules: Use for compact proof points or before/after metrics.
Keep chart inside a scene-local clip.

timingGuidance: Use for app or website screenshots that need a physical-device read without requiring a full 3D model.
usageRules: Treat the device as the primary self-framed object.
Animate the screen inside the bezel rather than animating raw width or height.
Use only when the screenshot has enough vertical content to pan.

timingGuidance: 7–9s scene; reveal nodes first, draw SVG edges, then reveal labels with tl.set.
usageRules: Use for decision trees, branching processes, or agent workflows.
Keep nodes and connectors in one scene-local clip.

timingGuidance: Drive fixed grain offsets from the paused timeline across the scene duration.
usageRules: Use when a flat scene needs subtle analog texture.
Do not use infinite CSS animation.

timingGuidance: Use a deterministic center/edges stagger around the scene swap point.
usageRules: Use for tile cover/reveal transitions between already-mounted scenes.
Never use random stagger origins.

timingGuidance: Use for a 4-6 second source image beat when a static image needs editorial motion without becoming a generic card.
usageRules: Use only with high-resolution images that can tolerate safe 9:16 cropping.
Keep the movement slow enough to preserve source legibility.
Pair with source-attribution-strip when the image came from a public source.

timingGuidance: 5–7s beat; slide follow pill after scene context, pulse button once.
usageRules: Use for quick follow CTAs.
Keep handle and avatar generic until final brand pass.

timingGuidance: Deprecated text watermark pattern; replace with brand-logo-watermark.
usageRules: Do not use in new shorts.
Keep only for migration context.

timingGuidance: Use as a short brand or partner-logo emphasis beat before a proof or payoff scene.
usageRules: Use for one primary logo only; use brand-logo-cloud for multiple logos.
Do not replace the required brand-logo-outro.
Keep it scene-local, not persistent like brand-logo-watermark.

timingGuidance: Upstream-only reference; fetch on demand and use as a small punctuation overlay.
usageRules: Use for system-alert metaphors or task reminders.
Keep it subordinate to the main scene.
validationRules: sourceDemo empty allowed only for reference entries

timingGuidance: Use for geography, logistics, migration, or coverage beats where a simple map route communicates the story faster than text.
usageRules: Use simplified maps unless precise cartography is required.
Keep the path deterministic with static SVG coordinates.
Pair with source-attribution-strip when based on an external map or dataset.

timingGuidance: Use for a product/app/object hero when a 2.5D turntable is enough and full WebGL is not justified.
usageRules: Use transparent PNG/WebP assets when possible.
Do not use for screenshots; use device-screen-pan instead.
Keep the rotation subtle so it remains seek-stable and readable.

timingGuidance: Upstream-only reference; fetch the source block when authoring and convert to inline seek-safe markup.
usageRules: Use for community-commentary beats or anonymized discussion prompts.
Do not import remote composition at runtime.
validationRules: sourceDemo empty allowed only for reference entries

timingGuidance: Use for 0.45–0.7s scene handoffs, especially before the final brand outro.
usageRules: Set outgoing and incoming scenes with autoAlpha, scale, and filter:blur instead of removing them from the DOM.
For the final brand outro, combine the scene handoff with the required grouped blur scale-up text reveal from brand-logo-outro.

timingGuidance: Use for a source screenshot or product UI when only one region matters and the rest should recede.
usageRules: Animate the screenshot object directly; do not wrap it in a second generic card.
Use a focus mask to direct attention instead of cropping away context.
Keep labels outside the screenshot unless they are part of the captured source.

timingGuidance: Run a 1.2–1.6s highlight pass after the target is visible.
usageRules: Use container variant on pills, buttons, or cards.
Use text variant on display type without a container background.

timingGuidance: 5-7s opening scene; reveal source badge, headline, metadata, and image crop before moving into proof.
usageRules: Use for source URL hooks where the audience must recognize the publisher, URL path, and thesis quickly.
Keep publisher identity secondary to the short's own cgaravitoq brand system.
Use repo fonts only; source brands can influence color and public assets but not typography.

timingGuidance: Persistent or scene-local 2-6s strip; fade in after primary content and fade before cgaravitoq outro when used near the ending.
usageRules: Use as compact source attribution inside source-driven scenes and outro support beats.
Never replace the required cgaravitoq watermark or final brand outro.
Keep URL labels short, readable, and secondary to the main scene hierarchy.

timingGuidance: 5-7s before/after or pain-point scene; reveal cells in a deterministic order and spotlight the chosen source thesis.
usageRules: Use for business-process arguments such as stale docs, version drift, low adoption, or long training cycles.
Keep the grid scene-local; do not wrap it in another generic card unless the grid is loose unframed content.
Use source colors only as accents, not as the persistent brand identity.

timingGuidance: Use as a fast source visual reveal when an external image should enter with proof-like intent.
usageRules: Use with source.json assets when source attribution is required.
Keep the reveal under one second so it reads as a beat, not the whole scene.
Avoid stacking with shimmer-sweep unless the source image is low contrast.

timingGuidance: 6-8s workflow scene; reveal nodes left-to-right, draw connectors, then lock final action node with tl.set.
usageRules: Use instead of generic flowchart for source theses that convert raw knowledge into context, format, and action.
Keep connectors deterministic and avoid async or random layout.
Use as an open canvas or full-scene frame when the pipeline has more than four nodes.

timingGuidance: 4-6s support beat; reveal publisher/author identity first, then paraphrased proof and attribution.
usageRules: Use for author, customer, or brand proof where a paraphrased claim needs visible attribution.
Do not quote long copyrighted text; keep proof copy paraphrased and use a short source label.
Use repo fonts and cgaravitoq watermark/outro even when the card references an external brand.
Never place this component inside the final brand outro scene; it is a support beat, not a closing brand element.

timingGuidance: 5-8s proof scene; reveal rows, grow bars, then hold highlighted source-backed metric and citation label.
usageRules: Use when a public source contains a numeric comparison, adoption claim, benchmark, or timeline delta.
Keep labels short enough for 9:16 scanning and attach a compact citation label inside the component.
Use seek-safe timeline tweens for bar scale and tl.set for discrete emphasis states.

timingGuidance: Upstream-only reference; fetch on demand for audio, podcast, playlist, or creator-media scenes.
usageRules: Use when a compact media card is enough.
Do not represent it as a full player UI unless the script needs that.
validationRules: sourceDemo empty allowed only for reference entries

timingGuidance: Use for route, dependency, or trend-line reveals when the line itself is the point.
usageRules: Use stroke-dashoffset animation instead of path morphing for deterministic renders.
Use with fixed paths only; no runtime-generated random path data.
Keep node labels separate from the SVG when text needs responsive fitting.

timingGuidance: Use for full-scene presenter beats where a transparent VP9-alpha cutout (speaker.webm) is hole-cut into the composition. Pair with an inverse-alpha plate (plate.webm) on track 0 so background layers, headlines, and overlays read above the subject. Typical beat is 5-10s.
usageRules: Wrap each <video> in a non-timed div; opacity/scale tweens target the wrapper, not the <video> element, because the runtime force-applies position:absolute and 100%x100% on tracked stage children.

Drop the subject cutout (speaker.webm) on a mid-to-high scene track and the inverse-alpha plate (plate.webm) on background track 0 so HTML headlines on intermediate tracks can sit behind the head and above the plate.
Generate speaker.webm and plate.webm with `bunx hyperframes remove-background <presenter>.mp4` — first-party path is HeyGen, but any presenter MP4 works (webcam, D-ID, Synthesia, Veo).
Do not commit speaker.webm or plate.webm. Push them to R2 and list them in assets.remote.json so `bun run hydrate:episode <slug> --manifest=assets` restores them.
Use `playsinline muted` on the <video> elements so the Chromium renderer auto-decodes alpha frames seek-safely; do NOT use `autoplay` or `loop`.
Treat the subject as a self-framed object — do not wrap it in a generic glass/card container.

timingGuidance: Deprecated; evaluated and dropped due to unstable readability.
usageRules: Do not use until a stable masking technique is validated.
Prefer shimmer-sweep for text emphasis.

timingGuidance: 5–7s beat; pop overlay and add fixed steps(1) glitch offsets.
usageRules: Use for faster high-contrast follow beats.
Avoid infinite CSS animations.

timingGuidance: Use as a short social-proof card; reveal after surrounding scene context.
usageRules: Use when the post content is the visual beat.
Keep handles and content generic unless attribution is cleared.

timingGuidance: 5–7s lower-third; slide up after context and pulse subscribe CTA once.
usageRules: Use for YouTube-style channel context.
Place above scene-local layers without colliding with tracks 97–99.
